profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. describes itself as a provider of conversational AI agents for enterprise use. According to the company's website, its OASYS platform powers voice-native AI agents that resolve service, operations, and commerce conversations for enterprise brands. The site includes customer testimonials stating that the technology helps resolve requests faster, process orders more efficiently, and deliver always-on voice experiences.

The company is a public company headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, trading under the ticker SOUN, with SEC CIK number 0001840856. It is incorporated in Delaware. The available data lists 33 Delaware litigation exposure entries, though no individual case details are provided.
